description: Conduit fill calculator (NEC Chapter 9) — Electrical conduit fill check for THHN/THWN-2 conductors in EMT, PVC Schedule 40, PVC Schedule 80 or rigid metal conduit, using NEC Chapter 9 Table 4 conduit areas and Table 5 conductor areas. Returns total conductor area, the Table 1 fill limit (53% one wire, 31% two, 40% three or more, 60% for short nipples), fill percent for every trade size 1/2 to 4 inch, the smallest size that passes, the smallest size in the other conduit types, and for a chosen size the spare area and how many more of the largest conductor fit. For a single wire size it also lists the maximum number of conductors per trade size (Annex C rounding). Params: conduit (emt, pvc40, pvc80, rmc) and wires as size:count pairs, e.g. 12:3,12:1 (AWG 14-1, 1/0-4/0, kcmil 250-500). Optional: size (trade size like 3/4 or 1-1/4), nipple=yes. Offline; verify against your adopted code edition. Price: $0.003 USDC (Base, via x402).
